Young, beautiful, strong, brave, admirable, loved, loving&hellip;''"<br />"''I will.|Alema Rar exchanges her last words with Jagged Fel via telepathy|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>}}
A '''skirmish''' took place at an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] known as [[The Home]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Alema Rar]] was chased to The Home by her pursuers, the [[Alema Rar Task Force]], composed of [[Jagged Fel]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], and [[Zekk]]. After the ensuing fight, Fel broke Rar's neck with [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Crushgaunt/Legends|crushgaunts]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] her.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Is that what I hope it is?''"<br />"''Probable coordinates for Brisha Syo's habitat. Care to go there and have a picnic?''"<br />"''Definitely. You tell the tall fellow with half a name. Should I invite your parents?''"<br />"''I think they have a right to be there.|Jagged Fel and Jaina Solo|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Fury" />}}
During the [[Battle of the rendezvous point]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]], [[Zekk]] and [[Jagged Fel|Jag]], boarded the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|Anakin Solo]], after Leia convinced her [[Darth Caedus|son]], Jacen, who unknown to her now calls himself Darth Caedus, to let her board the Anakin Solo, thinking she was alone on the [[Love Commander]]. While Leia was escorted to the Command Salon to meet her son, the others were hiding in the secret compartments on the Love Commander.
